## Top Free Cloud Storage Options 2026
### Google Drive Free Tier
Google Drive remains a staple for anyone already using Gmail, Docs, or Photos. The free plan gives you 15 GB shared across Drive, Gmail, and Google Photos (if you opt for “Storage saver” quality). The web interface is clean, and the desktop/mobile apps sync flawlessly. Real‑time collaboration on Docs, Sheets, and Slides is a major plus for students and remote teams. If you’re deep in the Google ecosystem, this is often the easiest free choice.

### Microsoft OneDrive Free
OneDrive offers 5 GB of free storage, tightly woven into Windows 11 and Microsoft 365 web apps. The standout feature is the seamless integration with Office Online—you can edit Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files directly in the browser. OneDrive also includes a personal vault for extra‑sensitive files, using two‑factor authentication and encryption. For users who rely on Outlook or Teams, the free tier provides a smooth experience without leaving the Microsoft world.

### Dropbox Basic
Dropbox still gives 2 GB free, but it compensates with a reputation for reliability and speed. The sync engine is known for handling large files and frequent changes with minimal lag. Dropbox Paper offers a lightweight collaborative note‑taking space, and the mobile app excels at automatic camera upload
